en.summary: Before Olivia Benson became a household name, Mariska Hargitay showcased her acting chops in diverse roles. Discover her standout performances outside the iconic Law & Order: SVU.
en.body:
## 1. Carly Fixx (Falcon Crest: Seasons 7 & 8)
Before she was dishing out justice, Hargitay embraced her wild side as Carly Fixx in the dramatic soap opera "Falcon Crest." Her portrayal of a country outlaw, complete with a Southern accent, was a bold departure from the gritty realism of SVU, showcasing an early willingness to explore edgier characters and demonstrate her range.

## 2. Cynthia Hooper (ER: Season 3)
Hargitay brought a different kind of intensity to the emergency room as Cynthia Hooper, a nurse at County General. Appearing in 13 episodes of the beloved medical drama "ER," her character navigated the high-stakes environment of the hospital, offering a glimpse into Hargitay's ability to blend vulnerability with professional competence.

## 3. Didi Edelstein (Can't Hurry Love: Season 1)
In this short-lived ABC sitcom from 1995, Hargitay played Didi Edelstein, a woman dealing with the ups and downs of dating and friendship in New York City. While the show itself didn't last long, Hargitay's presence as a relatable, quirky character proved she could handle comedic timing and lighter fare, a skill essential for any versatile performer.

## 4. Guest Spot on The Larry Sanders Show
While specific details are scarce, Hargitay made appearances on the groundbreaking HBO comedy "The Larry Sanders Show." This platform allowed her to flex her comedic muscles in a more satirical and adult-oriented environment, working alongside comedic legends and demonstrating an adaptability to different tones and genres.

## 5. Early Film Roles (e.g., "Welcome to New York")
Long before her television dominance, Hargitay appeared in films like "Welcome to New York" (1999). These early film roles, though often smaller, provided crucial experience in on-camera performance and character development, laying the groundwork for the nuanced portrayals she would later deliver on the small screen.
Bottom Line: Mariska Hargitay's career is a testament to an actress who consistently sought out diverse roles to hone her craft, proving her talent extended far beyond the precinct.

content_raw: Mariska Hargitay is best known for playing Olivia Benson, but some of her most entertaining TV work came in roles that even longtime fans may have forgotten.
